name: 60-t20-pan-foreign-ir-probe
incident: 2026-10-07 Wyze Pan v1 (T20/jxf22, OpenIMP, timps a006fca): boot in the dark cellar, night, silent probe r=1.20, day for the rest of the night
description: The field numbers of cam-wyze-pan, 15:15-15:16 CEST: it came up in day (running_mode=0) reading 3489, the boot probe read the day pipeline at 3587 (analog 128, IT 1967/2246) and switched to night. The night pipeline then read 401 with the illuminator (analog 66, IT 843) and 483 without it: r=1.20, light the IR-cut filter removes (the other cellar cameras' illuminators). The dump is the open stack's isp-m0 with the compact T20 AE: it publishes MAX SENSOR analog gain 158 (the jxf22 maximum) and MAX ISP digital gain 0 while the AE stops at 128, so the plateau rule stays inert (cap 7838 > 4096) and a wrong day never ends. Before the fix the reference was the boot's day-pipeline 3489, path C fired 20 s into the night and the ratio said day. Now the reference is anchored from the night pipeline and every probe meets the proven-night gate: two switches (the boot measurement), night to the end.

expect_log: boot: measuring before deciding - persisted running_mode=0
switching to night \(boot: measured night, exposure 35\d\d\)
r=1\.2\d but the lit level 4\d\d is no brighter than the proven night reference 4\d\d
